user_story: As a user, I want to update the description of a task so that I can add more context.

positive.title: Update task description with valid input
steps: Update the description field with valid text
positive.expected_result: The task description is updated successfully and the new description is displayed on the task list.

positive.title: Update task description with special characters
steps: Update the description field with special characters (e.g., @,#,$,%)
positive.expected_result: The task description is updated successfully and the new description with special characters is displayed correctly.

negative.title: Update task description with empty input
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed stating that the description cannot be empty and the description is not updated.

negative.title: Update task description with an overly long input
steps: Update the description field with a text longer than the maximum allowed limit
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed stating that the description exceeds the maximum character limit and the description is not updated.

edge.title: Update task description with SQL injection attempt
steps: Update the description field with an SQL injection string (e.g., 'X'; DROP TABLE tasks; --)
edge.expected_result: The application handles the input safely, displaying an error message or rejecting the input, and the description is not updated.

edge.title: Update task description with HTML tags
steps: Update the description field with HTML tags (e.g., <script>alert('test');</script>)
edge.expected_result: The application sanitizes the input, either removing or escaping the HTML tags, and the task description is updated without executing any scripts.
